business-minimal.label: 商务极简
business-minimal.use: 管理汇报、方案沟通、领导层演示
business-minimal.art_direction: restrained executive presentation with calm confidence and generous negative space
business-minimal.composition: asymmetric editorial grid, conclusion first, one strong visual anchor, precise alignment
business-minimal.palette: warm off-white, near-black, muted forest green, restrained amber accent
business-minimal.typography: clean modern Chinese sans serif, large conclusion headline, short supporting lines, stable proportions
business-minimal.imagery: credible contemporary workplace or architectural photography with natural light
business-minimal.materials: matte paper, subtle rules, crisp image crops
business-minimal.text_layout: short headline at upper-left or lower-left, supporting copy directly below, generous clear margin
business-minimal.contrast: high text contrast; background behind text must be quiet, flat, or softly darkened

editorial.label: 编辑叙事
editorial.use: 行业观点、品牌故事、趋势演讲
editorial.art_direction: premium independent magazine spread with a strong point of view
editorial.composition: asymmetric page rhythm, serif-led headline, cropped documentary image, intentional tension
editorial.palette: paper ivory, carbon black, oxide red, muted marine blue
editorial.typography: high-contrast Chinese serif headline paired with restrained sans-serif supporting copy
editorial.imagery: documentary editorial photography with visible texture and honest light
editorial.materials: uncoated paper grain, hairline rules, print-like image treatment
editorial.text_layout: one editorial headline block with no more than two short supporting lines; keep the opposite half visually quiet
editorial.contrast: paper or deep-charcoal text field must remain readable; never place text over a busy face or high-frequency texture

launch-tech.label: 青蓝科技发布
launch-tech.use: 产品发布、技术演讲、开发者大会
launch-tech.art_direction: cinematic technology keynote, engineered and credible rather than science-fiction fantasy
launch-tech.composition: dark stage, strong left-to-right information flow, one luminous technical visual, clear focal hierarchy
launch-tech.palette: near-black teal, cool white, electric cyan, small warm amber signal
launch-tech.typography: precise geometric Chinese sans serif with occasional monospace micro labels
launch-tech.imagery: abstract data infrastructure, systems, light paths, or engineered macro photography
launch-tech.materials: dark glass, fine technical lines, restrained luminous edges
launch-tech.text_layout: cool-white headline in a clearly separated dark field, left aligned, with one cyan rule and sparse metadata
launch-tech.contrast: dark matte text field or clean negative space behind all copy; no bright light path may cross the letters

premium-dark.label: 高端暗色
premium-dark.use: 高端发布、精品展示、主旨演讲
premium-dark.art_direction: cinematic black-stage keynote with understated luxury and editorial restraint
premium-dark.composition: immersive full-bleed image, low-key lighting, elegant title placement, deep negative space
premium-dark.palette: rich black, warm ivory, brushed gold, restrained mineral teal
premium-dark.typography: elegant Chinese serif title with sparse modern sans-serif support
premium-dark.imagery: low-key cinematic photography with tactile detail and controlled highlights
premium-dark.materials: black lacquer, brushed metal, subtle film grain
premium-dark.text_layout: large warm-ivory title in deep negative space; supporting copy is sparse and never competes with the hero subject
premium-dark.contrast: use a controlled black vignette or matte panel behind text; highlights must not sit under the title
